title: Permit to work + simultaneous operations gate
description: Prepare hazard, isolation, and SIMOPS evidence in order, deconflict activities that cannot run together, and route the permit through an authority chain that cannot be reordered.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-well-03
  title: Permit to work + simultaneous operations gate
  description: Prepare hazard, isolation, and SIMOPS evidence in order, deconflict activities that cannot
    run together, and route the permit through an authority chain that cannot be reordered.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Authorize wellsite work only when hazards are assessed, isolation is proved at the point
    of work, and conflicting simultaneous activities have been resolved before any authority signs.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-authority-1
      - n-authority-2
      - n-authority-3
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Requested work and current wellsite activity
      summary: Requested work and current wellsite activity
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - work_request
              - active_operations
              - isolation_points
              - personnel_on_board
            properties:
              work_request: {}
              active_operations: {}
              isolation_points: {}
              personnel_on_board: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-scope
      kind: transform
      name: Select the work and the systems it touches
      summary: select the requested task, the systems it touches, and the isolations it requires
      config:
        operation: select
        expression: select the requested task, the systems it touches, and the isolations it requires
    - id: n-prep1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: well-08
      name: Hazard assessment for the task as scoped
      summary: 'Preparation step 1: hazard assessment for the task as scoped.'
      role: Coordinator running permit to work, isolation, and simultaneous operations control at the
        wellsite.
      prompt: 'You are a Drilling HSE & Permit Coordinator. You run permit to work, energy isolation,
        and simultaneous operations control: what work is authorized, who holds each authority, what is
        isolated, and which activities cannot run at the same time. You refuse a permit whose isolation
        has not been proved at the point of work, and you treat a change to the scope as requiring a new
        authorization rather than an amended one.'
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - compliance-review
          - evaluation
          - domain-analysis
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:permit-system
        permissions:
          - explicit-authorization-required
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-prep2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: well-08
      name: Energy isolation plan proved at the point of work
      summary: 'Preparation step 2: energy isolation plan proved at the point of work.'
      role: Coordinator running permit to work, isolation, and simultaneous operations control at the
        wellsite.
      prompt: 'You are a Drilling HSE & Permit Coordinator. You run permit to work, energy isolation,
        and simultaneous operations control: what work is authorized, who holds each authority, what is
        isolated, and which activities cannot run at the same time. You refuse a permit whose isolation
        has not been proved at the point of work, and you treat a change to the scope as requiring a new
        authorization rather than an amended one.'
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - compliance-review
          - evaluation
          - domain-analysis
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:permit-system
        permissions:
          - explicit-authorization-required
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-prep3
      kind: agent
      templateRef: well-04
      name: Well control effect of the requested work
      summary: 'Preparation step 3: well control effect of the requested work.'
      role: Well control engineer maintaining two tested barriers between the reservoir and the environment.
      prompt: You are a Well Control & Barrier Engineer. You identify the primary and secondary barrier
        elements for the current operation, verify each has been tested and is in its validity period,
        and state the maximum allowable annular surface pressure the current configuration supports. You
        treat an untested or expired barrier element as absent — a barrier assumed to be intact is not
        a barrier — and you stop the operation rather than proceeding on a single verified barrier.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - compliance-review
          - evaluation
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:drilling-data
        permissions:
          - explicit-authorization-required
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-preparation
      kind: group
      name: Permit evidence sequence
      summary: Each preparation step consumes the previous one; the group exits only after the whole sequence
        has been serialized in the order the permit requires.
      config:
        members:
          - n-prep1
          - n-prep2
          - n-prep3
        execution: sequential
        exit: serialize
    - id: n-conflict
      kind: condition
      name: Simultaneous operations conflict?
      summary: Route on the requested work conflicts with an active operation under simultaneous operations
        rules.
      config:
        expression: the requested work conflicts with an active operation under simultaneous operations
          rules
        branches:
          - label: Clear
            when: clear
          - label: Conflict
            when: conflict
    - id: n-deconflict
      kind: agent
      templateRef: well-06
      name: Resolve or reschedule the conflicting activity
      summary: Resolve the conflicting activity before any authority signs.
      role: Engineer optimizing drilling parameters without exceeding mechanical or hole-condition limits.
      prompt: You are a Drilling Performance Engineer. You optimize weight on bit, rotary speed, flow,
        and hydraulics against measured response — rate of penetration, vibration, torque and drag, hole
        cleaning — and you state the limit each parameter is bounded by. You refuse an optimization that
        trades hole condition or downhole tool life for short-term rate, because the stuck pipe or twist-off
        that follows costs more than the days it saved.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - optimization
          - decision-analysis
          - teaching
          - domain-analysis
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:drilling-data
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-authority-1
      kind: approval
      name: Isolating authority confirms and signs the isolation
      summary: Pause for the isolating authority; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: n-authority-2
      kind: approval
      name: Area authority authorizes work in the area
      summary: Pause for the area authority; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: n-authority-3
      kind: approval
      name: Offshore installation manager or well-site leader issues the permit
      summary: Pause for the installation manager or well-site leader; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Permit to work + simultaneous operations gate deliverable, the evidence
        behind it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-well-03-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-scope
      kind: data
    - id: wf-well-03-edge-2
      from: n-scope
      to: n-preparation
      kind: data
    - id: wf-well-03-edge-3
      from: n-preparation
      to: n-conflict
      kind: data
    - id: wf-well-03-edge-4
      from: n-conflict
      to: n-authority-1
      kind: control
      condition: clear
    - id: wf-well-03-edge-5
      from: n-conflict
      to: n-deconflict
      kind: control
      condition: conflict
    - id: wf-well-03-edge-6
      from: n-deconflict
      to: n-authority-1
      kind: data
    - id: wf-well-03-edge-7
      from: n-authority-1
      to: n-authority-2
      kind: control
      condition: approved
    - id: wf-well-03-edge-8
      from: n-authority-2
      to: n-authority-3
      kind: control
      condition: approved
    - id: wf-well-03-edge-9
      from: n-authority-3
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
